data.summary: Start playing Classic World early on Tuesday, October 6 with Classic World Founder's Packages!
data.body:
Global MapleStory Classic World is almost here, and you can start playing early on Tuesday, October 6 with Classic World Founder's Packages!

Each Founder's Package includes a unique hat, effect, outfit set, and more! In addition, the Zakum and Orange Mushroom packages give Founder's Access to Classic World on October 6, two weeks before the Grand Launch on Wednesday, October 21.


All Founder's Package items can be fully equipped or used by both male and female characters of all jobs. Additionally, all items are purely cosmetic and do not grant any stats or bonuses.

Head to the Classic World Founder's Packages page for the full details. You have until 11:59 PM PDT on October 14 to purchase or upgrade yours! Items can be claimed via the mailbox from the start of Founder's Access through Monday, November 30 at 11:59 PM (UTC). Note that the Founder’s Package can only be claimed once per account on each platform (once on the Nexon website and once on Steam), and you will need to leave Maple Island before you can open your Founder’s Package items. After claiming your package, you will have 30 days to open your package.

Limited-Time Collaboration
Only Available Until Oct. 7!

The Signature Style Collection contains a full outfit package, including hair and face styles, featuring our visitors from the “Frieren: Beyond Journey's End” collaboration! Check out the details here!

To buy, log in with a Nexon account and purchase the package with NX from the MapleStory Classic World Founder's Package page.

The Signature Style Collection items will be delivered automatically to your Classic World account during the Grand Launch. You can pick up the items from your in-game mailbox after leaving Maple Island on Classic World from Oct. 23 until Nov. 3 at 11:59 PM UTC. Please note that the items will no longer be available for pickup after Nov. 3 at 11:59 PM UTC. Signature Style Collection coupons and the resulting items cannot be traded in Classic World.
data.name: Classic World Founder's Packages Now On Sale!
